name: claude

spawn.doc: headless Claude Code: spawn a worker session with an explicit model; <prompt> is required (claude -p exits 2 without input)

list_models_note: Claude Code 2.1.x has no CLI model-list command. Obtain the list from the provider (Anthropic API /v1/models or the models your account can access) and write it to .pmos/available-models.txt in the same '- <id>' shape the recommender parses.

usage.doc: run with --output-format json and read usage.input_tokens / usage.output_tokens from the result

file_scope_hooks.doc: PreToolUse hooks can deny Edit/Write outside the worker's touches set (the gstack /freeze mechanism). hostgen renders host-bundles/claude/hooks-pretool-edit.json; the coordinator installs it per worker with the touches paths filled in.
